note: MainCliTest.shouldPrintEffectiveConfigWithSourceAndRedactSecrets: --print-config prints each property with its source and redacts a secret, without starting a server. Upstream sets JVM system properties; a process sets them from the environment (the oracle's -D options after --print-config are not read), which reports the source the same way. The masked lines are the image's own launch settings (its environment and its -Dmockserver.propertyFile)
